up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614234. For each activity, return the molecule's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity value, standard units, standard relation, and standard type.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_type
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614234'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
